title: Probability bound from an output cover
statement: Let a learning program with any access mode have outputs in a type $\alpha$, and let its target be a Boolean function. If every possible output satisfies at least one of two properties $A$ and $B$, then the probability that the program's output satisfies $A$ plus the probability that its output satisfies $B$ is at least $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A learning access mode and output type $\alpha$
A learning program with that access mode and output type
